daily_quests.title: ASX 200 Price Volatility Rankings with Window Functions
daily_quests.description: Using ASX 200 historical prices dataset, calculate daily percentage change for each stock using LAG window function. Then use ROW_NUMBER to rank stocks by volatility (standard deviation of percentage changes) within each month. Finally, identify the top 3 most volatile stocks per month using a CTE. Your output should show: month, rank, stock_code, volatility_score, and average_daily_change. Filter for 2024 data only.

daily_quests.title: NSW Road Crash Data Cleaning & Feature Engineering
daily_quests.description: Download NSW Road Crash Data and perform comprehensive data cleaning: handle missing values in severity, speed_zone, and weather columns; standardise date formats; remove duplicate crash records; validate latitude/longitude bounds for NSW (between -28.0 to -34.0 and 140.0 to 154.0). Engineer new features: crash_hour (extract from time), is_nighttime (between 18:00-06:00), and weather_category (group rare weather types into 'Other'). Output a cleaned CSV with 15+ columns. Document all transformations in comments.

daily_quests.title: Australian Wine Production Analysis Pipeline
daily_quests.description: Part 1 (Python): Fetch or load Australian wine production statistics by region and vintage year. Clean the data: handle missing production volumes, standardise region names (remove whitespace/case inconsistencies), remove outliers using IQR method on production volume. Export to a CSV named 'wine_clean.csv'. Part 2 (SQL): Load the cleaned data into a database table. Write a query using CTEs and window functions to: (1) calculate 3-year rolling average production per region, (2) rank regions by total production volume, (3) identify regions with year-on-year growth exceeding 10%. Output: region, vintage, production_volume, rolling_avg_3yr, region_rank, yoy_growth_pct. Limit results to top 20 regions by total production.
daily_quests.dataset: Australian Wine Production Statistics — wineaustralia.com or agriculture.gov.au
